cards.card_text: Paul says the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight, and he backs it up with Scripture from Job 5:13: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.” Then Paul quotes Psalm 94:11: “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
cards.verse_text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight.
cards.snippet: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight.

cards.card_text: Then Paul starts listing gifts: to one the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge, to another faith, to another gifts of healing.
cards.verse_text: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit, to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
cards.snippet: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit, to another…
